craft_evidence.owned: yes for boots/totes only - evidence (brand statement naming places and headcount): Brunswick and Lewiston, Maine facilities, over 400 employees, make the Maine Hunting Shoe/Bean Boot and the Boat and Tote (llbean.com Company Information PDF, undated; L.L.Bean Canada company info, 2015 figures). Bean
craft_evidence.makers: NONE on 33 clothing PDPs and 4 shoe PDPs read 2026-10-10
craft_evidence.mills: NONE named; fabric origin only: Chamois Shirt "woven just for us in Portugal", Scotch Plaid flannel "Portuguese flannel... woven exclusively for L.L.Bean", Wool Peacoat "Fabric woven in Italy exclusively for L.L.Bean"; Signature Heritage Denim washes made "in partnership with our mill" (unnamed)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed (brand claim): founded 1912 by Leon Leonwood Bean; original shop Freeport, Maine 1917; Maine Hunting Shoe 1912 (company history page says invented 1911); Field Coat 1924 ("since 1924"
craft_evidence.process: Bean Boot only: triple-line stitch joining rubber and leather; stitchers trained 26 weeks; sewn in Maine one pair at a time (llbean.com Built to Last, 2020-11-25; Bean Boot PDP). Clothing: constructio
craft_evidence.reasoning: L.L.Bean owns real making - the Brunswick and Lewiston, Maine factories (400+ staff) that sew the Bean Boot, stated on the boot PDP ("Made in Maine") and in the company PDF - but it covers boots and totes, not the clothing. All 33 men's clothing PDPs read say only "Imported", name no maker or mill, and give at most a fabric country (Portugal flannel, Italian peacoat wool). A 4 is arguable on the owned boot factory if the map scores footwear; on the clothing it is a 2-3.

ownership.owner: L.L.Bean, Inc. - privately held, family-owned (Bean/Gorman family; Shawn Gorman, great-grandson of L.L., Executive Chairman). No annual report published.

opview: “Sell good merchandise at a reasonable profit, treat customers like human beings and they'll always come back for more.” — Leon Leonwood, L.L.Bean Canada Company Information page (Operations > Customer Service)
